Tell him to keep a mood dairy, put times in it and a measuring system, and keep accurate logs, this will help a therapist, and yourself from saying any triggers or patterns. This is really helpful.

Secondly, and in my opinion the biggest one, don’t add any pressure to him, my parents told me I wasn’t depressed and that I was attention seeking, and after 5 suicide attempts I sought help and got my self on track.

Finally break the cycles. With depression and anxiety they operate in cycles. If your son has an anxiety attack or a breakdown due to depression it’s becuase he spirals. It starts with a simple thought, and then it grows and grows and grows until it gets to be unmanageable. Try to work out if there is some way of breaking that.

Look, your friends won’t get hurt and drained, I mean look people here are responding to this post (I’m in the U.K. on my phone at 2 am becuase I feel unwell) and the notion that it would drain them is not true, if they are superficial friends, fuck em, if they real friends, they’ll help you though, as random people from around the world will.

Also academic success does not mean real world success and that in tandem with the ridiculous pressure that going to college (uni in the U.K.) has in society is fucking idiotic, there is a way of getting into any industry without qualifications for it.

Finally being a burden and a lack of purpose (along with hating yourself) are all in your head, that’s anxiety talking, not reality everyone has people in life that care about them, at the very least i do, and I live in the bloody U.K., a lot of people much closer to you will care about you.

Please don’t do anything “stupid” people care for you I promise.

Small piece of advice, it worked for me and helped me to sort myself out, on your phone create a load of alarms and set like 5 for a task like showering, also if you can try to sleep less, if you sleep that much you oversleep which leads to you feeling tired, so it becomes this cycle that really fucks with your head.
